newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL DENIES RETAILERS CANCEL FUEL CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: MOL DENIES RETAILERS CANCEL FUEL CONTRACTS.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt denied on Monday its petrol retailers were seeking to revise contracts after alleged quality problems in some north Hungarian counties.
"Contrary to press reports, none of our wholesale partners has initiated the cancelling or modification of existing contracts," MOL said in a statement.

Press reports said on Monday that after a series of incidents in which car fuel pumps broke down in the region of the north-east Hungarian city of Miskolc, German service station group Aral's Hungarian unit decided to purchase petrol from Austria until MOL solves the problem.
MOL said that the quality of its petrol meets Hungarian standards but that it will take two weeks to complete an investigation into the causes of the reported problem.
MOL added that meanwhile it will supply the north Hungarian region with petrol from its Szazhalombatta refinery. Normally the region receives its petrol from MOL's Tiszai refinery.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, MOL shares closed at 4,460 forints, down 520.
